title: GRADE 10 - UNIT 2 - TASK 5 - COLLOCATIONS & PHRASES SET 2

cards.front: make a choice to do something
cards.speakText: make a choice to do something
cards.backContent: đưa ra lựa chọn làm gì
cards.example: We can make a choice to use fewer plastic products.

cards.extra1: be in use — đang được sử dụng
cards.example: Turn off devices that are not in use.
Families can cut down on electricity use by switching off unused lights.

cards.extra1: break down naturally — phân hủy tự nhiên
cards.extra2: a machine breaks down — máy móc bị hỏng
cards.example: Some materials take hundreds of years to break down.

cards.extra1: throw away + rubbish / plastic / old items
cards.example: Do not throw away things that can be reused.
Plastic waste can cause damage to marine life.
Environmental education should be compulsory for all students.

cards.backContent: kết luận lại; nói tóm lại
cards.extra1: Used to introduce the final point or summary.
cards.example: In conclusion, small daily actions can help protect the environment.
Saving energy at home can make a difference to the environment.
Our group gave a presentation on reducing plastic waste.
Students searched for information about renewable energy.
Our class decided to use reusable bottles.

cards.front: make a decision to do something
cards.speakText: make a decision to do something
cards.backContent: đưa ra quyết định làm gì
cards.example: The school made a decision to reduce single-use plastic.

cards.extra1: be based on + noun / evidence / information
cards.example: The project is based on ideas from students and teachers.
Reusable containers are used for storing food.
